verdict.rationale: Elastic Observability's Cases feature lets teams track investigation details, assign tasks and collaborate on resolutions, which covers declaring and tracking incidents in a basic way. On-call schedules and escalation policies are not evidenced. Routing alerts to third-party incident management systems is an external-tool workaround and earns no credit. Missing for 10: incident timelines, on-call schedules, escalation policies, and in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration of incident tracking.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can declare and track incidents with timelines, on-call schedules, and escalation policies

citations.quote: Cases allows teams to stay aware of potential issues and track investigation details, assign tasks, and collaborate on resolutions.
